sentences.en: Some Africans wear ornamental scars to identify their tribes.
sentences.zh: 一些非洲人会在脸上刻装饰性的疤痕来识别自己的部落。

sentences.en: Male Bowerbirds build fascinating ornamental structures called "bowers" to attract mates.
sentences.zh: 雄性织布鸟会建造引人注目的装饰性结构称为‘巢穴’以吸引伴侣。

sentences.en: The larvae of June beetles can damage the roots of ornamental plants.
sentences.zh: June beetle 的幼虫可能会损害观赏植物的根部。

senses.zh: 装饰的，装饰用的n.观赏植物,装饰物
